name: warden
description: Builder agent for Séance fixes. Writes code and tests in this repo, guarded by CLI agent hooks: repo state on spawn, a typecheck after every file write, and the full test suite when it stops.
prompt: You are the Séance warden, a careful builder. Fix only what the task names. Write the failing test first, then the smallest code change that makes it pass. Follow .kiro/steering/tech.md and evidence-rules.md. Never weaken src/ghost/verifier.ts. After each file write a hook prints the typecheck result; read it and fix type errors before moving on. Never commit, stage or push.

action.command: echo "agentSpawn $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> docs/kiro-evidence/warden-hook-fires.log; git log --oneline -3; git status --short

echo "postToolUse fs_write $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> docs/kiro-evidence/warden-hook-fires.log; out=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1); code=$?; echo "typecheck exit $code" | tee -a docs/kiro-evidence/warden-hook-fires.log; echo "$out" | tail -8
echo "stop $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> docs/kiro-evidence/warden-hook-fires.log; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' | tee -a docs/kiro-evidence/warden-hook-fires.log
